statements.text: New terminal summaries expose elapsed whole seconds rounded down.
Measure the specified accepted execution interval with a monotonic clock, including termination cleanup and excluding final persistence.
Retain Unix-millisecond timestamps, version-1 fields and emitted order, CLI behavior and supported Python runtimes.
Preserve readable historical summaries until an ordinary acquired run replaces them; do not infer historical units or add migration.
Preserve failure classes, counters, single-flight behavior, owner-private state and lifecycle snapshot authority.
Use deterministic existing test seams to validate rounding, wall-clock changes, terminal outcomes, timeout cleanup, running nulls, legacy preservation and overlap.
Risk remains elevated because wrapper checksums can reload an enabled host job; preview the loader, preserve enablement and defer activation during an active refresh.
Deliver one draft PR with applicable gates and scoped managed deployment, operation and recovery evidence; preserve summaries and projections on rollback.
Do not implement other audit findings, tool or dependency migrations, unrelated validator changes or a forced real refresh.
